explanation: UnitAt K P x is a custom definition: x = r/s inside K with r, s ∉ P. The theorem says these elements are closed under multiplication. Mathlib has no declaration with this predicate. The nearest results are the localization at a prime, `Localization.AtPrime`, and `Submonoid.mul_mem`. Using them would mean translating this ad hoc predicate into membership in the image of the localization or into a submonoid. That takes more than a one- or two-line derivation. I found no single Mathlib lemma that gives this statement directly.
